[[Yammiron, Ether Lord]] is a [[Roaring Ether]] [[boss]] that appears in [[The Mirror of Lyss]].

== Locations ==
* [[Vabbi]]
** {{NPC location|The Mirror of Lyss}} 

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Energy Burn}}
* {{skill icon|Energy Surge}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Ether Feast}}
* {{skill icon|Mistrust}}
* {{skill icon|Wastrel's Demise}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Roaring Ether Claw]]
* [[Yammiron's Focus]] ([[unique]])

== Notes ==
* Yammiron, Ether Lord will not appear in the Mirror of Lyss if [[The Search for Survivors]] is active.
* The [[Roaring Ether (Vabbi)|Roaring Ether]]s can [[resurrection|resurrect]] him; consider taking them out first.
* In [[Hard mode]], Yammiron and his group can [[wipe]] a party with [[Energy Surge]] [[spike]]s. Keep spread out and try to prevent them from launching coordinated attacks. It helps to bring [[AoE]] skills such as [[interrupt]]s (e.g. [[Panic]] or [[Psychic Instability]]), [[knock down]]s (e.g. [[Meteor]]), or [[daze]] (e.g. [[Broad Head Arrow]]).
